controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery over the Hudson–Ostro–Scheeres shape reconstructed from 1992 and 1996 radar observations. This is a simplified model, not a photographic texture or measured albedo. Later radar and Chang’e-2 images reveal differences from this model. The long axis is displayed in a fixed arbitrary orientation; the light does not reproduce a specific observation.
controls.summary: Shape from 1992 and 1996 radar data. Later images show differences; the gray grid marks missing imagery.
controls.title: Radar shape model

controls.label: Chang’e-2
controls.description: The original camera sampled about 8.3 m per pixel. This published image has been enlarged and cropped, with its colors and lighting preserved. Craters and boulders are visible, but their positions on the radar shape remain approximate. The back, limb and uncertain patches stay gridded.
controls.summary: A photograph from 13 December 2012, taken at 67.7 km range. Placement on the radar model is approximate; the grid marks excluded terrain.
controls.title: Chang’e-2 photograph
